Start Time in UTC (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss)

Comma-separated list of Tracepoint IDs
Comma-separated list of Zone Type IDs. ”-2” for Self Zone and “-3” for Third Party Zone.

Comma-separated list of Availability Filter IDs. (OnlyFailures = 0, OnlySuccesses = 1, All = 2, OnlyContentFailures = 3, OnlyJavascriptFailures = 4, SLA = 5, SLAAcceptedRuns = 6, SLAPurgedRuns = 7, RealTimePushApiFailures = 8)
Include Verify on Error Run. Default is false.
